messages:
jess: hey team — pinging for a quick security review on PR #7423, planning to merge Fri if green. touches on on-prem auth service + VPC KMS policy changes. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/7423 — short summary below
raj: can you paste the specific tf diff and call out any new IAM roles or service accounts? also, did the secret scanner run on the branch?
jess: sure. tl;dr: added a customer-managed KMS key with a policy allowing cross-account decrypt from the onprem-auth service, and a small change to auth service to fetch rotated keys. no new plaintext secrets. tf snippet:
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "onprem_redwood" {
  description = "Onprem key for auth token encryption"
  policy      = jsonencode({
    Statement = [
      { Effect = "Allow", Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/onprem-auth" }, Action = "kms:Decrypt" }
    ]
  })
}
```
jess: and in auth service we added a call to KMS to decrypt tokens during startup, plus a feature-flag to fallback to local dev key if not present.
sec-scan-bot: secret-scan: no high-risk plaintext secrets detected in branch 7423 (scan id: sc-2026-04-03-91). commit 6a1f2d: flagged 1 potential config string (LOW) — see scan report: https://scans.redwood/7423
matt: thanks. does this require HSM/KMS key material to be provisioned by infra, or can the service create it at runtime? need to know for onboarding and key rotation docs.
jess: infra will provision the key; PR includes terraform for the key so infra ops needs to apply in staging first. i'll add a short runbook in the PR description for rotation and emergency revoke.
raj: please run the key-rotation script in a staging environment and paste the logs here. also share the IAM policy diff for the role so i can check for over-permissive actions.
jess: will run it in ~30m and post logs. rotation command:
`./scripts/kms_rotate.sh --env staging --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234`
ow: the role policy change is just granting kms:Decrypt for the onprem-auth role, nothing broader.
owen: happy to review the PR tonight, i can focus on the runtime auth change and breakpoints. assign to me?
matt: per process we need 2 sec approvals + infra ops sign-off before we merge to main. tagging @eng-infra for apply window. if no blockers by EOD we'll schedule a canary rollout to onprem staging and monitor token flows for 24h.
jess: thanks all — i'll post the rotation logs and update the PR with the runbook. @owen @raj appreciate the review. :thumbsup:
